item.name: One-on-One Individual Stand-Up Paddle Lesson
item.description:
#STAND UP PADDLING is becoming one of the fastest-growing water sports. Because of its ideal conditions, Waikīkī is one of the best places to learn how to stand up paddle.

##Duration
- 1.25hrs

##About
We offer BEGINNER and ADVANCED stand up paddling lessons for anyone that is interested in trying out this unique hybrid sport that is a cross between surfing and canoe paddling.

Beginner SUP lessons will cover the fundamentals of balancing, paddling and turning on a stand up paddle board. You may see a turtle or two while paddling over the reef—so keep an eye out! 

Advanced lessons, for those who are already comfortable on a SUP board, will learn how to catch and surf waves. *Note: all of our Waikīkī Beachboys are lifeguard and CPR certified and licensed by the state of Hawaiʻi to conduct lessons in Waikīkī.*

**Lesson Times:** SUP lessons are conducted daily at:

 - 8:30 a.m.
 - 10:00 a.m.
 - 11:30 a.m.
 - 1:30 p.m.
 - 3:00 p.m.

##Additional Information:

 - All SUP lesson participants must be able to swim.
 - Participants 13 and younger may not participate in SUP lessons due to safety reasons.
 - Lessons are a total of 1.25 hour in length and include 15 minutes of safety briefings on the sand.
 - All surfing equipment is provided, including use of a rash guard.
 - All surf instructors are licensed by the state of Hawaiʻi and fully trained in CPR and other life-saving techniques.
 - Pregnant women or guests with prior neck or back injuries should not take SURF / SUP lessons.

facts.hygiene_policy:
Your safety and the safety of our staff are our highest priorities. All participants, including minors, must complete an electronic liability waiver before participating in any Waikīkī Beach Services activity or rental. A link to the waiver will be included in your confirmation email. We recommend completing all waivers before your scheduled activity to help expedite check-in.

Some activities and rentals have minimum age requirements. Please provide accurate participant ages when booking. Guests who do not meet the age requirement or appear to be under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be permitted to participate, and no refund will be issued.

Please do not leave personal belongings unattended on the beach or at the pool. Limited storage is available for shoes and towels, but valuables should be left in a secure location. Waikīkī Beach Services and its staff are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.

**Royal Hawaiian Beach Desk**
If you are a guest of the Royal Hawaiian or Sheraton Waikīkī Hotel, the Royal Hawaiian Beach Desk is located on the Royal Hawaiian pool deck and can be accessed by walking through the hotel. 

If you are not a guest of the two Marriott properties above and are joining us, you can use the Beach Access Lane on Kalākaua Ave located between The Cheesecake Factory and Outrigger Waikīkī Hotel. The walkway is lined by surfboards and will take you directly to our beach desk.
